doc.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011

title: Sampling Cannonball and closing music
summary: Mercy Mercy Mercy sample, closing music and thanks.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well do you want to close with a little bit of music?

Oh, and by the way, when I was poking through the things on the internet, you sampled Cannonball and his — was it his “Mercy Mercy” thing? “Sometimes we’re not prepared for adversity.” [Cannonball’s spoken introduction to “Mercy, Mercy, Mercy.”]
Yes. “You know sometimes we’re not prepared for adversity.” And then that song was a track I made on my keyboard synthesizer.
Yeah. I got a kick out of that.
I had to stick him in somewhere.
I do not have my horn.
I remember that was the first song you taught me. That and “Sack O Woe.”
